Definition: to quit, i.e. allow to remain
BiblicalUsage: To leave alone is sometimes mercy and sometimes judgment. Darius is told to let the work of the house of God alone, and the elders are to build it in its place, but Daniel hears that God's kingdom shall not be left to other people: it shall break in pieces and consume all the kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word turns on who is doing the leaving, for men are told to leave God's work alone while God will not leave His kingdom to another, and I hold that His kingdom is the one that stands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
